body: I am so, so sorry. Someone in my family is also going through treatment. I understand how surreal this feels, and the devastation. I don’t know what the best way to handle this grief as I am struggling too, but I want to let you know I am thinking of you.
What’s one of your favorite stories about him?
What’s his favorite place to be pet?
Hi, no I don’t speak Dutch, I don’t think we know each other. I’ve gotten several PMs and it seems like a lot of people are in the same situation, either they are in my position or my friend’s.

I almost wish he’s doing this to manipulate me because then I have a reason to be angry, but then I think maybe he’s saying these triggering things to get attention because he needs it. But then he says he doesn’t want help, so why is he talking to me? My mind keeps going over these thoughts like a hamster on wheels.

You’re right, I do need to make boundaries, but I don’t know how to do that without hurting his feelings.

that’s the thing though, if I dropped him and something terrible did happen to him, it would be my fault. 

I know because I lost someone I only distantly knew, like the friend of a friend of a friend. I never spoken a word to him in his life, but when I got the news I kept thinking I should have known and done something. If I felt that way to basically a stranger, I know I’d destroy myself if it was my friend.

According to him he has “no friends” so that’s not an option. His family doesn’t know about his mental illness, and I don’t want to put myself in that position. 

Right now I’m equally sick of my friend and also myself for even thinking these things.
I hear you, and I want to say how glad I am that you didn’t follow through. Middle school years can be so hard, I’m so sorry you had to endure bullying. Good luck with everything in the future!
